name: Nehirde Oyun
scene: A playful river otter floats among flowing river ribbons and riverbank reeds.
notes: Target 80–120 panes. Otter uses copper and gold; river and reeds use turquoise and blue. Inspired by vitray fox and lighthouse design references, with the original story_otter image used only for subject. Generated with clai image and visually inspected; one revision removed open toe strokes, simplified eyes and restored a white exterior. Remaining concerns for tracing: subtle fill shading persists, some adjacent subject panes share gold, and several reed/belly junctions and narrow tail tips need geometry review. Pane count and T-only topology are not certified. Design sheet only.
